frameworkDetail: Next.js 16.4.5 App Router (app/), React 19.2.0, TypeScript 5.8.3; gsap 3.13, three 0.181, @rive-app/react-canvas. No data-fetching library, no server actions, no API routes, no fetch() to any backend, no env vars. Branch claude/sleepy-mayer-f0hkb8. Excluded: app/lab/** (developer lab), app/admin/** (being built by another agent), components/styles/_fixtures.ts (lab-only).
dataLayerPattern: OFFLINE-FIRST SIGNALS PRESENT, sync strategy required in Phase 0 (conventions.md already rules: always-online, server is the only truth; localStorage keeps only theme, a remembered tab, and the unsent maker draft). There is NO network layer: every screen is a 'use client' component that reads browser storage, either directly through lib/account.ts or through a per-area 'seam' module that declares the server contract in comments and implements it against localStorage. (1) Account store: lib/account.ts holds the whole signed-in person as ONE JSON blob in localStorage 'fw-account' (Account {name, contact, here, handle, creator, bio, pro{plan,business}, space, pass, dates[], wishes[]}); hook useAccount() returns [account|undefined|null, save]; pages read account.wishes / account.dates directly and write with save({...account, ...}) or putWish/dropWish. lib/maker.ts saveWish() writes drafts into that same blob on every maker step, plus a side note 'fw-maker' and voice 'fw-voice-<id>'. (2) Seams (each documents REST paths in JSDoc comments, e.g. '/** GET /pro ... */', '/** POST /pro/logins */', 'POST /studio/ai/draft', 'GET /v1/styles/levels'): lib/feed-api.ts (async listFeed/getWish/react/save/follow/share/listCreators/listNewStyles; store 'fw-feed'), lib/pro-api.ts (hook usePro() + async createClientWish/savePerson/importPeople/approveDate/saveBrand/inviteLogin/removeLogin/buyPlan/getInvoiceFile; store 'fw-pro' via lib/pro-data.ts loadPro/savePro), lib/vault-api.ts (async getStorage/listShoots/getShoot/createShoot/uploadFiles/removeShoot/sendReveal/getReveal/sendFavourites/getDownload; store 'fw-vault'), lib/studio-api.ts (Promise<Result<T>> getCreator/setPlan/buyCredits/draftStyle/changeStyle/listDrafts/saveDraft/submitStyle/listMyStyles/setTemplate/listTemplates/getEarnings/getPayouts; store 'fw-studio'; Studio components call it as `api` via components/app/studio/ctx.tsx useLoad), lib/levels.ts (levels(), levelOf, stylesAt; no store, answers from style manifests). Errors are typed per seam (FeedError/ProError/VaultError codes offline|full|not_found|no_wishes|failed; studio Result.reason). Live refresh is by window events ('fw-account', 'fw-pro', 'fw-vault', 'fw-studio', 'storage'). (3) Static content (ruling candidates for staying local): lib/catalog.ts (kinds, occasions copy, tickets/extras/pass/concierge prices as naira strings, house showcase wishes, STYLE_COPY), lib/occasions.ts (recipes: chapters per kind+occasion), lib/engine/packages.ts + components/styles/** (style manifests), lib/engine/registry.ts + lib/engine/moments.ts (openings/endings), lib/wish-model.ts (chapter content model), lib/pro-data.ts PLANS/VAULT/VAT, lib/studio.ts plans/credits. (4) Seeds: one switch ('Show sample wishes' on /app/you) inserts four Wish rows with ids 's-*' into 'fw-account'; every other fixture file is gated by samplesOn() = account has a wish whose id starts with 's-'. HOW TO READ ONE SCREEN'S DATA NEEDS: open the page under app/**; follow its imports from lib/ (useAccount -> the Account/Wish/DateRow types in lib/account.ts; usePro -> ProData/ClientWish/Person/Invoice/Login/Brand in lib/pro-data.ts; vault-api Shoot/VaultFile/Storage/RevealPlay; feed-api FeedWish/Creator/FeedStyle/FeedPage; studio-api CreatorState/StudioStyle/SubmittedStyle/Earnings). The seam's exported request/response TypeScript types ARE the intended contract; the JSDoc above each function names the intended method+path. Fields read in JSX (account.wishes.filter(...)) give the read shape; each save()/seam call gives an action. Money today is naira (number in pro-data/studio, formatted string in catalog), not kobo.
